reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Good on you for bringing him along. At 11 the goal is technique, movement quality and enjoying it, not loading heavy. Bodyweight work, light dumbbells or bands, a few easy sets of 8 to 12 reps, and you right there coaching form is the right shape. I can't build a program for a kid, so check with his pediatrician or a youth coach for what suits him. In the meantime, let's get your own training dialed in."}
